name: The Fool
meaning_upright: Spirit of Aether, pure potentiality, the zero-point of becoming, divine madness, limitless freedom.
meaning_reversed: Folly, heedlessness, extravagance, mania, the ungrounded spirit.

name: The Magus
meaning_upright: Mercury, skill, wisdom, communication, cunning intelligence, the divine trickster, transmission of will.
meaning_reversed: Will misdirected, cunning turned to deception, wasted potential, trickery.

name: The Priestess
meaning_upright: The Moon, silver light, the veil between worlds, pure intuition, the silver throne of initiation.
meaning_reversed: Surface knowledge, blocked intuition, hidden secrets turned destructive.

name: The Empress
meaning_upright: Venus, love, beauty, creative force, abundance, the great mother of all manifestation.
meaning_reversed: Vanity, dissipation, luxury masking emptiness, creative stagnation.

name: The Emperor
meaning_upright: Aries, solar fire, authority, war, constitution of reality, the archetypal father.
meaning_reversed: Domination, war for ego, rigidity of form without spirit.

name: The Hierophant
meaning_upright: Taurus, revelation of hidden things, the inner teacher, the keeper of sacred law.
meaning_reversed: Dogmatism, blind faith, distortion of sacred teaching, conformity without wisdom.

name: The Lovers
meaning_upright: Gemini, the alchemical marriage, union of opposites, the royal wedding of spirit and matter.
meaning_reversed: Unresolved inner duality, indecisiveness, inappropriate relationships.

name: The Chariot
meaning_upright: Cancer, the Holy Grail, triumph of the spirit, mastery of the chariot of consciousness.
meaning_reversed: Uncontrolled forces, scattered will, tyranny without direction.

name: Adjustment
meaning_upright: Libra, cosmic equilibrium, karma, the mathematical truth of existence, perfect balance.
meaning_reversed: Imbalance, karmic debt unpaid, injustice, consequences avoided temporarily.

name: The Hermit
meaning_upright: Virgo, the inner light, the sacred serpent, solitary wisdom, the lamp of initiatory knowledge.
meaning_reversed: Excessive isolation, misanthropic withdrawal, wisdom hoarded not shared.

name: Fortune
meaning_upright: Jupiter, the Wheel of the Law, the spinning of the three principles of creation.
meaning_reversed: Resistance to the law of cycles, fighting fate, clinging to the past.

name: Lust
meaning_upright: Leo, Babalon and the Beast conjoined, the ecstasy of strength, joy in the creative life-force.
meaning_reversed: Misdirected passion, lust without love, brutality, loss of the divine spark.

name: The Hanged Man
meaning_upright: Water, the dying and reborn god, redemptive sacrifice, the reversal of perspective that brings illumination.
meaning_reversed: Futile sacrifice, martyrdom without meaning, stagnation, refusing to let go.

name: Death
meaning_upright: Scorpio, the scorpion, eagle, and serpent, the transformation of matter, the purifying power.
meaning_reversed: Fear of transformation, clinging to the decaying, resistance to shedding the old.

name: Art
meaning_upright: Sagittarius, the alchemical art, blending sun and moon, the great work of spiritual refinement.
meaning_reversed: Failed integration, work abandoned, imbalance of inner forces.

name: The Devil
meaning_upright: Capricorn, Pan, the creative-destructive generative force, the blind force of nature, creative ecstasy.
meaning_reversed: Bondage to the material, self-destructive drives, the blind force misused.

name: The Tower
meaning_upright: Mars, the lightning-struck tower, war, the destruction of the false ego by divine fire.
meaning_reversed: Avoided disaster, internal revolution, suppressed but not released.

name: The Star
meaning_upright: Aquarius, Nuit, the starry body of heaven, cosmic consciousness, the dissolution into the infinite.
meaning_reversed: Disenchantment, loss of cosmic connection, despair, impurity of channel.

name: The Moon
meaning_upright: Pisces, the flux and reflux of the astral tide, the path through the subconscious ocean.
meaning_reversed: Seduction by illusion, psychic confusion, fear overwhelming the traveler.

name: The Sun
meaning_upright: Resh, the solar consciousness, the twin children of the new Aeon, joy and clarity.
meaning_reversed: Blocked solar energy, pride, egotism, dimness of consciousness.

name: The Aeon
meaning_upright: The new Aeon of Horus, final judgment and rebirth, the formula of the child replacing the dying god.
meaning_reversed: Refusal of the new formula, clinging to the old Aeon, resistance to cosmic evolution.

name: The Universe
meaning_upright: Saturn, Tav, the final synthesis, the dancing figure of matter perfectly animated by spirit.
meaning_reversed: Stagnation, inability to complete the work, falling short of the great synthesis.

name: Ace of Wands
meaning_upright: The root of the powers of Fire, pure creative force, the Will to begin.
meaning_reversed: False start, will misdirected, creative potential blocked.

name: 2 of Wands
meaning_upright: Mars in Aries: Dominion, swift and daring power, the lord of the flame.
meaning_reversed: Impatience, aggression without wisdom, will without direction.

name: 3 of Wands
meaning_upright: Sun in Aries: Virtue, established strength, the first victory of the will.
meaning_reversed: Virtue compromised, energy dissipated, weak foundations.

name: 4 of Wands
meaning_upright: Venus in Aries: Completion, the perfection of mundane force, the work finished.
meaning_reversed: Incomplete work, stagnation at the threshold, deferred joy.

name: 5 of Wands
meaning_upright: Saturn in Leo: Strife, the Lord of Strife, energy at battle with itself.
meaning_reversed: Avoidance of necessary conflict, suppressed tensions.

name: 6 of Wands
meaning_upright: Jupiter in Leo: Victory, the great triumph, success crowning long effort.
meaning_reversed: Arrogance in victory, hollow triumph, success built on sand.

name: 7 of Wands
meaning_upright: Mars in Leo: Valour, courage under pressure, the fight for what is right.
meaning_reversed: Surrender, cowardice, exhaustion of will.

name: 8 of Wands
meaning_upright: Mercury in Sagittarius: Swiftness, the arrow in flight, the Lord of Swiftness.
meaning_reversed: Delays, loss of momentum, energy scattered.

name: 9 of Wands
meaning_upright: Moon in Sagittarius: Strength, great force held in reserve, resilience.
meaning_reversed: Weakness, abuse of force, strength turned inward.

name: 10 of Wands
meaning_upright: Saturn in Sagittarius: Oppression, cruel and despotic energy, the weight of fire.
meaning_reversed: Release from oppression, end of tyranny, freedom from burden.

name: Princess of Wands
meaning_upright: The earthy part of Fire, enthusiasm, courage, impetuous energy, the dawn of creation.
meaning_reversed: Superficiality, instability, cruelty without wisdom.

name: Prince of Wands
meaning_upright: The airy part of Fire, swift and fierce, action and intellect combined.
meaning_reversed: Cruelty, bigotry, rushing forward blindly without care.

name: Knight of Wands
meaning_upright: The fiery part of Fire, the supreme expression of Fire, the warrior of the Aeon.
meaning_reversed: Rashness, violence, foolhardiness, insolence.

name: Queen of Wands
meaning_upright: The watery part of Fire, adaptability with fire's passion, kindness and generosity.
meaning_reversed: Sternness, vanity, jealousy, obstinacy.

name: Ace of Cups
meaning_upright: The root of the powers of Water, love overflowing, the grail of the spirit.
meaning_reversed: Love withheld, blocked emotional flow.

name: 2 of Cups
meaning_upright: Venus in Cancer: Love, harmony in duality, the perfect union of equals.
meaning_reversed: Imbalance, co-dependency, disharmony in union.

name: 3 of Cups
meaning_upright: Mercury in Cancer: Abundance, the overflowing cup, the feast of the heart.
meaning_reversed: Excess of pleasure, indulgence, the feast grown hollow.

name: 4 of Cups
meaning_upright: Moon in Cancer: Blended pleasure, the quiet pool of contentment.
meaning_reversed: Superficial pleasure, discontent beneath the surface.

name: 5 of Cups
meaning_upright: Mars in Scorpio: Disappointment, the lotus in stagnant water, sorrow.
meaning_reversed: Lingering in sorrow, self-pity, refusing to move forward.

name: 6 of Cups
meaning_upright: Sun in Scorpio: Pleasure, the gentle joy of inner harmony.
meaning_reversed: Pleasure denied, harmony disturbed, superficial enjoyment.

name: 7 of Cups
meaning_upright: Venus in Scorpio: Debauch, the cup overflowing with excess, corruption.
meaning_reversed: Recognition of corruption, sobriety, clearing the stagnant waters.

name: 8 of Cups
meaning_upright: Saturn in Pisces: Indolence, the dreamer who will not wake.
meaning_reversed: Awakening, stirring from slumber, facing what was avoided.

name: 9 of Cups
meaning_upright: Jupiter in Pisces: Happiness, the greatest happiness attained.
meaning_reversed: Happiness lost, disillusionment, transient joy.

name: 10 of Cups
meaning_upright: Mars in Pisces: Satiety, the cup filled beyond desire, ending in numbness.
meaning_reversed: Restored desire, overcoming numbness, rekindled passion.

name: Princess of Cups
meaning_upright: The earthy part of Water, dreamy, gentle, with a reflective surface hiding depths.
meaning_reversed: Seduction, idle dreaming, deception, unstable emotions.

name: Prince of Cups
meaning_upright: The airy part of Water, subtle and artistic, the Lord of the Waves.
meaning_reversed: Duplicity, unsteadiness, self-serving charm.

name: Knight of Cups
meaning_upright: The fiery part of Water, the intensity of emotion, the swift arrival of feelings.
meaning_reversed: Brutality beneath elegance, obsession, emotional cruelty.

name: Queen of Cups
meaning_upright: The watery part of Water, the great sea of the soul, pure intuition.
meaning_reversed: Evil and obsession, dreaming that harms, self-indulgence.

name: Ace of Swords
meaning_upright: The root of the powers of Air, the invoked force of mind, pure intellectual truth.
meaning_reversed: Confusion, poor judgment, the mind turned against itself.

name: 2 of Swords
meaning_upright: Moon in Libra: Peace, the still mind after conflict, temporary truce.
meaning_reversed: Tension returning, the peace broken, restlessness.

name: 3 of Swords
meaning_upright: Saturn in Libra: Sorrow, the Lord of Sorrow, grief as a teacher.
meaning_reversed: Mental recovery, release from sorrow, the dawn after the storm.

name: 4 of Swords
meaning_upright: Jupiter in Libra: Truce, rest from strife, a pause in the war.
meaning_reversed: The truce breaking, avoidance of necessary conflict.

name: 5 of Swords
meaning_upright: Venus in Aquarius: Defeat, failure of the intellect, humiliation.
meaning_reversed: Reconciliation, accepting defeat with grace, lessons learned.

name: 6 of Swords
meaning_upright: Mercury in Aquarius: Science, earned success through intellectual mastery.
meaning_reversed: Hubris, knowledge without wisdom, scientific coldness.

name: 7 of Swords
meaning_upright: Moon in Aquarius: Futility, the wheel of futility, effort without progress.
meaning_reversed: Recognizing futility, changing direction, releasing what cannot work.

name: 8 of Swords
meaning_upright: Jupiter in Gemini: Interference, too many thoughts, distraction, blocked success.
meaning_reversed: Clarity returning, distraction overcome, the mind focused.

name: 9 of Swords
meaning_upright: Mars in Gemini: Cruelty, despair, the weight of multiple blows.
meaning_reversed: Mental masochism recognized, self-compassion, acceptance.

name: 10 of Swords
meaning_upright: Sun in Gemini: Ruin, the ruin of everything by the mind's own force.
meaning_reversed: Survival, turning toward the light, rebuilding from ruin.

name: Princess of Swords
meaning_upright: The earthy part of Air, keen intellect on the edge, swift analysis.
meaning_reversed: Cruelty of mind, viciousness, indecisive brutality.

name: Prince of Swords
meaning_upright: The airy part of Air, the fullest expression of mind, mastery of concept.
meaning_reversed: Cunning without conscience, brutal cleverness, manipulation.

name: Knight of Swords
meaning_upright: The fiery part of Air, strength and bravery combined with mind, active intelligence.
meaning_reversed: Imprudence, violence, rashness, destruction without purpose.

name: Queen of Swords
meaning_upright: The watery part of Air, keen and subtle perceptive force, the widow's wisdom.
meaning_reversed: Sorrow misused, cruelty of thought, narrow-minded judgment.

name: Ace of Disks
meaning_upright: The root of the powers of Earth, material completion, the philosopher's stone.
meaning_reversed: Greed, hoarding, sterility of material possession.

name: 2 of Disks
meaning_upright: Jupiter in Capricorn: Change, the Lord of Harmonious Change, fluctuation in matter.
meaning_reversed: Unstable change, poor management of resources.

name: 3 of Disks
meaning_upright: Mars in Capricorn: Works, the great work, skill and labor rewarded.
meaning_reversed: Work abandoned, poor craftsmanship, wasted effort.

name: 4 of Disks
meaning_upright: Sun in Capricorn: Power, the established power, law and order in matter.
meaning_reversed: Blocking the flow, greed, obstruction of generosity.

name: 5 of Disks
meaning_upright: Mercury in Taurus: Worry, material anxiety, the weight of financial fear.
meaning_reversed: Liberation from worry, practical solutions found, relief.

name: 6 of Disks
meaning_upright: Moon in Taurus: Success, material success, the moon's gift of abundance.
meaning_reversed: Success built on weakness, hollow prosperity.

name: 7 of Disks
meaning_upright: Saturn in Taurus: Failure, the Lord of Failure, delay and discomfort.
meaning_reversed: Recovery from failure, patience after loss, slow return.

name: 8 of Disks
meaning_upright: Sun in Virgo: Prudence, the intelligent husbandry of resources.
meaning_reversed: Prudence becomes miserliness, anxiety paralyzing wise action.

name: 9 of Disks
meaning_upright: Venus in Virgo: Gain, material gain, increase, the blessing of Venus in the earth.
meaning_reversed: False profits, gains that bring no satisfaction.

name: 10 of Disks
meaning_upright: Mercury in Virgo: Wealth, the great wealth of the physical world, legacy.
meaning_reversed: Wealth mismanaged, burden of material success, spiritual poverty.

name: Princess of Disks
meaning_upright: The earthy part of Earth, generous and laborious, the practical magic of material manifestation.
meaning_reversed: Wastefulness, mismanagement of resources, prodigality.

name: Prince of Disks
meaning_upright: The airy part of Earth, steady and reliable, the skillful worker in matter.
meaning_reversed: Sluggishness, obstinacy, materialistic stagnation.

name: Knight of Disks
meaning_upright: The fiery part of Earth, the warrior's practical wisdom, material mastery.
meaning_reversed: Dullness, slowness, jealousy, lack of material ambition.

name: Queen of Disks
meaning_upright: The watery part of Earth, the dark mirror of prosperity, the abundance of nature.
meaning_reversed: Poverty of spirit despite material wealth, distrust, melancholy.
